script_text: This week the cosmos drags Scorpio into a fierce tug‑of‑war between desire and duty, testing your water‑sign depth. Monday Mercury in Gemini trines Pluto in Aquarius, activating your 8th‑house deep secrets and 4th‑house roots. Tuesday Venus in Gemini squares Saturn in Pisces, sharp cooling 8th‑house intimacy and 5th‑house romance. Wednesday Mercury enters Cancer, moving the mind to your 9th‑house beliefs as the critical Mercury‑Pluto trine peaks. Thursday Jupiter in Taurus expands 7th‑house partnerships while Uranus there sparks unexpected sudden shifts. Saturday Mars in Leo squares Uranus in Taurus, forcing an intense career‑versus‑partnership showdown for your water‑sign grit. Wednesday is your major power day as Mercury enters Cancer and the Mercury‑Pluto trine peaks. Tuesday is especially toughest when Venus squares Saturn, chilling intimacy and creative flow. Direct Mars’ drive into a focused project today and let Pluto remodel your home base. Follow for daily updates.
